name: Restart
source:
"The story revolves around Erick, who after a tragic event (which changes his life completely) the character chooses to move to a new city to finish his studies and make new friends while trying to forget what happened in the past.

After moving to a new city in Japan, the character tries to get used to the new people and customs of that place, trying to lead a normal life again.

In this city he meets his new school where he will study until he graduates, and there he makes new friends and maybe even something more. But it won't be that easy! The problems that the character has acquired over time interfere with the unfolding of the plot!

[From [url=https://projectrestart.itch.io/restart-ev]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“故事围绕埃里克展开，他在经历了一场悲惨事件（彻底改变了他的生活）后，选择搬到一个新城市完成学业并结交新朋友，同时试图忘记过去发生的事情。

搬到日本的一个新城市后，角色试图适应那个地方的新人民和习俗，试图再次过上正常的生活。

在这座城市，他遇到了他的新学校，他将在那里学习直到毕业，在那里他结识了新朋友，甚至可能结识更多的东西。但这不会那么容易！随着时间的推移，角色出现的问题干扰了情节的展开！”

[来自[url=https://projectrestart.itch.io/restart-ev]itch.io[/url]]
